message.text:
A systematic scan of internal/ will count inbound calls for every function to find the highest fan-in.

Writing a script to automate the inbound-call count.

args.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os, re, subprocess

root = "/bench/repo"
internal = os.path.join(root, "internal")

# Collect all func declarations in internal (non-test)
decls = []  # (symbol, path, line, package_import_path, is_method, receiver)
for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(internal):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, root)
        # package import path from module
        import_path = "github.com/usememos/memos/" + os.path.relpath(dirpath, root).replace(os.sep, '/')
        pkg_name = None
        with open(path) as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        m = re.search(r'^package (\w+)', content, re.M)
        if m:
            pkg_name = m.group(1)
        for m in re.finditer(r'^func (?:\(([^)]*)\) )?(\w+)\(', content, re.M):
            recv, name = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            if name == 'init':
                continue
            line = content[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1
            decls.append({
                'name': name,
                'path': rel,
                'line': line,
                'import_path': import_path,
                'pkg': pkg_name,
                'recv': recv.strip() if recv else None,
            })

# Build grep patterns for each symbol - focus on exported and likely high fan-in
# Count references across repo excluding test files and the declaration itself
results = []
for d in decls:
    name = d['name']
    # skip very generic short names that would false-positive
    if len(name) <= 2 and name not in ('AI',):
        continue
    
    # Use ripgrep if available else grep
    patterns = []
    if d['recv']:
        # method: count .MethodName(
        pat = rf'\.{re.escape(name)}\('
    else:
        # package func: count pkg.Name( or for subpackages full import usage
        pat = rf'\b{re.escape(name)}\('
    
    try:
        cmd = ['grep', '-r', '--include=*.go', '-E', pat, root]
        out = subprocess.check_output(cmd, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        out = ''
    
    callers = []
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if '_test.go' in line:
            continue
        caller_path = line.split(':', 2)[0]
        caller_rel = os.path.relpath(caller_path, root)
        # skip declaration file line for function body self-recursion? count all non-test
        callers.append(caller_rel)
    
    # For package-level funcs, filter to likely correct package calls
    if not d['recv']:
        pkg = d['pkg']
        filtered = []
        for c in callers:
            # keep if in same package dir or import alias usage
            filtered.append(c)
        callers = filtered
    else:
        # method calls - keep all .Method( matches
        pass
    
    fanin = len(set(callers))
    results.append((fanin, d['name'], d['path'], d['line'], d['recv'], len(callers)))

results.sort(reverse=True)
for fanin, name, path, line, recv, raw in results[:25]:
    sym = f"({recv}).{name}" if recv else name
    print(f"{fanin:4d} raw={raw:4d}  {sym}  {path}:{line}")
PYEOF

A grep for "Validate" returned 64 matches, but most are unrelated methods, so this search is too broad.

A precise bash script will list all internal/ function declarations and count unique callers per symbol.

args.command:
bash << 'BASH'
root=/bench/repo
internal=$root/internal

# collect declarations: file|line|kind|symbol|pkg|recv
declare -a entries
while IFS= read -r file; do
  rel=${file#$root/}
  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$file" | awk '{print $2}')
  dir=$(dirname "$rel")
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    entries+=("$line")
  done < <(grep -n '^func ' "$file" | grep -v '_test.go' | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
    if echo "$rest" | grep -q '^func init('; then continue; fi
    if echo "$rest" | grep -Eq '^func \([^)]+\) [A-Za-z0-9_]+\('; then
      recv=$(echo "$rest" | sed -E 's/^func \(([^)]+)\) ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(.*/\1/')
      name=$(echo "$rest" | sed -E 's/^func \(([^)]+)\) ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(.*/\2/')
      echo "$rel|$ln|method|$name|$pkg|$recv"
    elif echo "$rest" | grep -Eq '^func [A-Za-z0-9_]+\('; then
      name=$(echo "$rest" | sed -E 's/^func ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(.*/\1/')
      echo "$rel|$ln|func|$name|$pkg|"
    fi
  done)
done < <(find "$internal" -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go')

best_fanin=0
best_sym=""
best_path=""
best_line=""

for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r rel ln kind name pkg recv <<< "$entry"
  # skip unexported with very short names unless same-package only
  [[ "$name" == init ]] && continue

  if [[ "$kind" == method ]]; then
    pattern="\\.${name}\\("
  else
    pattern="\\.${name}\\("
  fi

  # count unique non-test caller files
  mapfile -t hits < <(grep -r --include='*.go' -E "$pattern" "$root" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_test.go' | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u)
  fanin=${#hits[@]}

  # for package funcs also count bare calls within same package directory tree
  if [[ "$kind" == func" ]]; then
    pkgdir="$root/$(dirname "$rel")"
    mapfile -t hits2 < <(grep -r --include='*.go' -E "\\b${name}\\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_test.go' | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u)
    # merge unique
    for h in "${hits2[@]}"; do
      found=0
      for e in "${hits[@]}"; do [[ "$e" == "$h" ]] && found=1; done
      if [[ $found -eq 0 ]]; then hits+=("$h"); fi
    done
    fanin=${#hits[@]}
  fi

  if (( fanin > best_fanin )); then
    best_fanin=$fanin
    if [[ "$kind" == method ]]; then best_sym="(${recv}).${name}"; else best_sym="${pkg}.${name}"; fi
    best_path=$rel
    best_line=$ln
  fi
done

echo "BEST: $best_sym $best_path:$best_line fanin=$best_fanin"

# also print top 15
declare -A scored
for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r rel ln kind name pkg recv <<< "$entry"
  [[ "$name" == init ]] && continue
  if [[ "$kind" == method ]]; then pattern="\\.${name}\\("; else pattern="\\.${name}\\("; fi
  mapfile -t hits < <(grep -r --include='*.go' -E "$pattern" "$root" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_test.go' | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u)
  if [[ "$kind" == func" ]]; then
    pkgdir="$root/$(dirname "$rel")"
    mapfile -t hits2 < <(grep -r --include='*.go' -E "\\b${name}\\(" "$pkgdir" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_test.go' | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u)
    for h in "${hits2[@]}"; do
      found=0; for e in "${hits[@]}"; do [[ "$e" == "$h" ]] && found=1; done
      [[ $found -eq 0 ]] && hits+=("$h")
    done
  fi
  fanin=${#hits[@]}
  if [[ "$kind" == method ]]; then sym="(${recv}).${name}"; else sym="${pkg}.${name}"; fi
  key=$(printf '%05d|%s|%s:%s' "$fanin" "$sym" "$rel" "$ln")
  scored["$key"]=1
done
printf '%s\n' "${!scored[@]}" | sort -rn | head -20
